model_payload_verification: Previously verified all 103 published payload SHA-256 hashes and all 113 file sizes with parent model-lock.json; not recomputed per score.
api_runtime: mlx-serve 26.9.4 / MLX 0.32.2; resident, text-only, context 65536, RAM prefix cache 4 GiB, KV quantization off; MTP/draft/PLD disabled per scoring request.
api_quality_correction: This initial quality-only run used an earlier harness without explicit warmup. Its manifest timing_scope incorrectly says warm. No warmup occurred; do not use it as a controlled speed comparison. API scoring implementation is unchanged from caf30c7.
native_quality_stage: Initial unfused RMSNorm/chunk256 implementation at 3418bcc; preserved separately from the final shared/chunk2048 evaluation.
quality_final: Compiled RMSNorm, chunk2048, exact-state grouping, singleton direct fast path. No untimed warmup; quality only.
speed_stage: Compiled RMSNorm, chunk2048. Explicit warmup then two timed repeats of one state / 21 decisions. Shape has no gold labels. API/direct/shared use identical prompt, input-token and answer-slot hashes. Shared suffixes sequential.
numerical_limits: Shared versus independent prefill flips one of 21 native decisions; shared agrees with the API on all 21. Probabilities differ. Do not claim bitwise/cache-boundary invariance or universal model/backend superiority.
gpu_tests: Small regression tests overlapped some quality runs and a portion of the API speed baseline; speed is a local indicative measurement, not an isolated-system certification.
published_results: Original results/raw hashes and 69 claims unchanged.
launcher_smoke: Final native shell launcher: 3 original smoke cases plus a 16-option category case all selected expected options; existing-output rerun rejected with exit 2 and unchanged SHA-256.
